walk-after-meals.precaution: If you take medicine that can cause low blood sugar, keep to your usual exercise precautions.

brisk-walking.precaution: Start at a pace you can manage. If you have unstable heart symptoms or have been told to limit brisk exercise, ask a clinician first.

question.ask: Have you been told to avoid vigorous exercise?
question.yes: Then skip fast stair climbing for now. A brisk walk may suit you better; ask your clinician what level is right.

stairs.precaution: Use a safe staircase with a rail. Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.

question.ask: Are you allergic to tree nuts?
question.yes: Then don’t add almonds. Choose another snack.

resistance-sarcopenia.precaution: If you’re frail or unsteady, plan the exercises with a clinician or physiotherapist first.

bath.precaution: Keep the water comfortably warm, not hot, and take care getting out if you get dizzy.

cyclic-sighing.precaution: Breathe gently. Stop if you feel light-headed.

question.ask: Do you have heart disease, uncontrolled blood pressure, an irregular heartbeat, or a condition made worse by cold?
question.yes: Then ask your clinician before trying cold water.

meal-order.precaution: If you take diabetes medicine, keep to your prescribed plan.

question.yes: Then don’t try this. Prunes are another option.

kiwi.precaution: See a doctor about new or lasting bowel changes.

question.ask: Do you have kidney disease, take a medicine that raises potassium (such as an ACE inhibitor, ARB or potassium-sparing diuretic), or have you been told to limit potassium?
question.yes: Then don’t switch salts. Extra potassium can be dangerous for you; ask your clinician or pharmacist.

whole-grains.precaution: Add fiber gradually if it upsets your stomach.

screen-cap.precaution: Keep access to the calls and messages you need.

question.ask: Do you have circulation problems in your legs, or a skin condition on your legs?
question.yes: Then ask a clinician before using compression stockings.

standing-stockings.precaution: Get stockings fitted to your size.

blink.precaution: See an eye-care professional for lasting symptoms, eye pain or changes in vision.

hummus.precaution: Check the ingredients if you have food allergies.

question.ask: Are you pregnant, or do you have osteoporosis, a past fracture, joint or back problems, or been told to avoid impact exercise?
question.yes: Then ask a clinician before doing jumps.

jumps.review: Confirm that the question alone is sufficient for healthy adults outside the studied group of young women.

question.ask: Do you have trouble swallowing, a possible bowel blockage, or have you been told to limit fluids?
question.yes: Then don’t start psyllium without your clinician’s advice.

psyllium.precaution: Mix each dose into a full glass of water and never swallow the powder dry. Ask a pharmacist how to space it from your medicines.

question.ask: Do you have circulation problems in your legs, or a skin condition on your legs?
question.yes: Then ask a clinician before using compression stockings.

flight-stockings.precaution: Get stockings fitted before you travel.

fall-hazards.intended: For older adults at risk of falls

question.ask: Has a clinician told you to limit how much you drink?
question.yes: Then don’t add this water; follow your fluid plan.

eat-slowly.precaution: Don’t force a chewing count if you have jaw, dental or swallowing problems.

mindfulness.precaution: Stop if you feel more distressed, and reach out for support.

smell-training.intended: For smell loss after a virus
smell-training.precaution: Get lasting or unexplained smell loss checked by a clinician first. Never put oils or anything else inside your nose.

question.ask: Do you have urinary symptoms right now, are you pregnant or breastfeeding, or have you been told to limit fluids?
question.yes: Then don’t start this. Get current symptoms checked, and follow your clinician’s fluid advice.

cystitis.guidance: This plan is for repeated, confirmed bladder infections, so set it up with the clinician who manages them.
cystitis.review: Whether clinician involvement is needed once a person confirms recurrent, diagnosed cystitis and none of the exclusions.

dash.precaution: If you have kidney disease or a potassium or fluid restriction, get dietary advice first. Don’t change your medicines.

nap.precaution: Give yourself time to wake fully before driving.

oats.precaution: If you need gluten-free food, choose oats labeled gluten-free.

pelvic-floor.guidance: The studied program is supervised: a clinician checks your technique and tailors the exercises.

question.ask: Do you have uncontrolled blood pressure, a recent heart problem, or have you been told to limit exercise?
question.yes: Then don’t start handgrip training. Ask your clinician first.

handgrip.guidance: The studied routine sets the grip at about 30% of your maximum with a force gauge, so a first session with an exercise professional sets it up.
handgrip.review: Whether a calibrated home device can replace the supervised first session, and the blood-pressure threshold for “uncontrolled”.

neck-strength.guidance: The studied program starts with a physiotherapist teaching the exercise and how to progress it.
neck-strength.precaution: Get new, severe or unexplained pain checked first.

question.ask: Do you have insomnia or sleep apnea?
question.yes: Then talk to a clinician first. More time in bed can make insomnia worse.

sleep-extension.review: Confirm that counseling is optional once insomnia and sleep apnea are excluded.

slow-breathing.precaution: Breathe gently. Stop if you feel light-headed. Keep taking any blood pressure medicine.

acupuncture-migraine.guidance: Acupuncture is given by a licensed practitioner; book a course of sessions with one.
acupuncture-migraine.precaution: Tell the practitioner if you take blood thinners or are pregnant.

weighted-blanket.precaution: You should be able to lift the blanket off yourself easily.

stair-walk-energy.precaution: Hold the rail and go at an easy pace. Stop if you feel dizzy or short of breath.

toilet-footstool.precaution: See a doctor about new or lasting bowel changes.

abdominal-massage.precaution: Skip it if you have belly pain that hasn’t been checked. See a doctor about new or lasting bowel changes.
